notes.title: Lying Souls - Chapter 2 & Content Update Now Available!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone,[/h3]
[b]The second chapter[/b] of Lying Souls is now ready for you to play. Dive into the mysterious continuation of the story about Redstack and their crazy plans.

It's not just the second chapter that offers new content. I've also reworked the prologue and chapter 1 from the ground up. There are now also the Steam Achievements that were missing before. Besides some QoL changes, there are also changes that have more influence on the gameplay. You can find the full patch notes below.

[h2]Chapter 2 Gameplay Trailer[/h2]
[b]Watch on YouTube now![/b]
[previewyoutube=znAz9RCGT0Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Sale[/h2]
As soon as [b]Chapter 2 is available on Steam[/b] (11 GMT-7 (20 MESZ)), there will also be a [b]special discount[/b] on Lying Souls. Be quick, the sale won't last long.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[b]Build v 1.1.0[/b]

[b]Additions / Changes:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added the second chapter
    [*]Reworked the whole prologue graphically and technically
    [*]Added [b](5)[/b] achievements
    [*]Added multi-page documents and notes
    [*]Added a setting for ambient volume
    [*]Added a setting for exposure / brightness
    [*]Added way more relevant dialogue text for story reasons
    [*]Implemented system that sounds adapt depending on where the player is
    [*]Implemented Unreal Engines Lumen technology
    [*]Changed the ending of chapter 1 for better understanding of the story
    [*]Changed the sounds of various object interactions
    [*]Changed game icon on Windows for better visibility
    [*]Changed the brightness and overall strength of the flashlight
    [*]Changed some level transitions
    [*]Improved movement system & feeling for motion
    [*]Improved readability for raw content text of the newspaper articles
    [*]Improved the settings menu for easier control of video & audio settings
[list][*]Added a setting for control of global illumination[/list] [*]Improved overall stability and performance
    [*]It is no longer required to switch on power in the final level of chapter 1
    [*]Updated to Unreal Engine 5.4
    [*]And much more...
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug that the end scene in chapter 1, could be activated multiple times
    [*]Fixed a bug that some sounds could not be heard after the master volume was set to 0% once
    [*]Fixed a bug where the landscape texture in some levels were displayed way too large
    [*]Fixed a bug where the chapter progress was not saved
    [*]Fixed various volumes ambient sound effects
    [*]Fixed an issue where the master volume partially did not affect some sounds
    [*]Removed collisions with physical objects that caused unwanted movements
    [*]Fixed the low shadows graphic settings not working properly
    [*]Fixed some sounds that should be 3D
    [*]Fixed various object placements
    [*]Fixed some audio volumes
    [*]Fixed some typos[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b][list]
   [*]Performance problems for some hardware in some levels
   [*]Some sounds continue to play even when the game is paused[/list]

[b]NOTE:[/b]
The performance got better, but I am still working on improvements for the performance on new as well as old hardware.

I hope you enjoy chapter 2 and the improved Lying Souls.

- Eric

notes.title: Lying Souls - Content Update News & Chapter 2 Preview!
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear players,[/h3]
Unfortunately, I had to pause the development of Lying Souls for the last few months due to personal reasons. Now I'm back at work and want to [b]continue developing the game[/b] and, above all, keep my promises. Now, you can expect the [b]content update[/b] and the planned [b]Chapter 2 in the next few weeks[/b], which will continue the story of the game. 

[h2]Steam Summer Sale[/h2]
Until [b]July 11[/b], there is still a [b]50% discount on Lying Souls[/b] with the [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b]. So grab it and get the full game and the upcoming content.

[h1]Content Update[/h1]
The content update will add some features that were already planned, but also some that players have requested or criticized for not being in the game. Chapter 2, offers players [b]a new experience[/b] anyway. In addition, the Prologue and Chapter 1 will also benefit from the update.

[b]Some upcoming new features:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Chapter 2 with the largest playable environment so far
    [*]New things to make the game feel more horror-oriented and creepy
    [*]Puzzles and tasks for the player
    [*]More ways to interact with objects
    [*]Completely reworked sound system
    [*]More translations in different languages
    [*]Several QoL changes
[/list] And much more. You can read the complete list of new features and changes as soon as the update has been released.

[h1]Chapter 2[/h1]
In the next chapter, the story continues and takes you on a more immersive journey than the previous chapters. There is more for the player to do, more to explore and, above all, [b]more to be scared of[/b]. Here are some impressions of Chapter 2:

notes.title: Lying Souls - Release & Development News
notes.notes:
[h2]News[/h2]
Hello everyone, I'm getting back to you personally after a long break to give you some information about the development, the release and the team.

Again an information about myself, I am and was the only developer of this project and received only intermittent support and encouragement in some places. I just used services for music composition and translation. Otherwise Lying Souls is all alone my project.

This will certainly remain so in the near future. That was also part of the reason for the longer break now. I still want to realize my vision, even if I'm not working with 10 other developers now. Of course, the whole thing takes a lot of time, which is why the release of Lying Souls has been postponed several times.

I've made some important decisions about Lying Souls, or much more the game studio itself, in the last few days. Actually relatively positive for everyone who wants to see Lying Souls and Troxy Studios become something.

So, but now enough background information about it, we come to Lying Souls. Development is going on at full speed now and will probably show some progress quickly, which I will also present to you. The schedule for Lying Souls will not be postponed. I also want to clarify as many open questions as possible about the game so that the whole thing finally becomes a little clearer.

[h2]Lying Souls[/h2]

[h3]Chapters[/h3]
As mentioned earlier, the chapters have now been adapted to the new plan from the game. You start with the prologue, which gives you a good idea of what to expect, and then you get the chance to play chapter 1 and then chapter 2.

[h3]Test version, beta, keys?[/h3]
Yes, there will be some keys for a test version of Lying Souls before the release. There are no plans for a public beta or anything like that at this time. Keys will be given to specially selected people, but also to random members of the community. The tests simply help us fix bugs ahead of time.

[h3]Languages[/h3]
The game will be available in several languages. At release, German and English will almost certainly be included. The plan is to add Spanish, French and perhaps Chinese in the future. Other languages may be added also.

[h3]Price[/h3]
Until recently, it was still unclear wether Lying Souls will be offered for free on Steam or not. I have now decided not to offer Lying Souls for free. The exact price at release is not yet clear. What is certain is that you will get the full game for the price.

[h3]Important notice[/h3]
There is no official assessment for an age restriction for Lying Souls yet. However, after some consultation with various people, the minimum age of 16 is recommended and the game is not suitable for players with mental problems or similar, as the game deals with very critical issues.

The next days there will be more information and new pictures on our Discord! If you don't want to miss it, check it out there. Have a nice week and I'll be back in the next post.

- Troxy Studios

notes.title: Lying Souls - Development State & Other News
notes.notes:
[h2]News[/h2]
There is a lot of news about Lying Souls and we will show you the current development state.

Recently, Lying Souls was included in the list of [b]Top Steam games in December[/b] by a gaming website. We wanted to thank you all together for that. [url=https://gameskeys.net/top-steam-games-to-tryout-in-december-2021/#LyingSouls]Go to the article here[/url].

We removed the [b]Redstack Edition[/b] of Lying Souls from the store. We decided to bring all the content of the edition into the main game.

The team size of Troxy Studios has changed. Lying Souls has actually always been a solo project, I just had help with the planning and looked for inspiration. The other team members, for example, checked my Lying Souls story for logic erros. So I am also the only developer of Lying Souls since the beginning and the others are part of the Creative Team.

We have published some very [b]meaningful leaks[/b] about Lying Souls in the last few days, regarding the story of the game. We will continue with that now until the release.

The last news for today is that we will be ready to release [b]Keys for YouTubers, Streamers and Curators[/b] of a preview version of the main game in the next 1-2 months. If there are still interested, get in touch with us.

[h2]Development State[/h2]
Now let's give you some more information about how Lying Souls is doing right now.

Right now, we are working on the game more than ever to get it ready as soon as possible. We would say that it's looking very good to release the game to you guys in the spring. It's our very first game, of which the story was created well before development.

The game will focus a lot on the [b]storytelling[/b] and less on the "action rich" gameplay. From your feedback of the demo, we also found that the majority felt the demo for Lying Souls was less of a horror game, and more of a mystery or story game.

This will also be the focus in the main game, though we all have to say, the main game is a lot [b]more uncomfortable and creepy than the demo[/b]. You will certainly have your moments where you feel extremely uncomfortable or scared.

One consideration on our part was also to completely adjust the chapters again. The current state is that there are [b]5 chapters[/b]. The first one is the prologue. Now we consider to reduce the number of chapters and thus also the contents of all chapters again to adapt. The prologue and maybe 2 more chapters so you can split the game.

Also the [b]development of the Achievements[/b] has progressed. Currently there are 7 Achievements. The number will surely increase until the release. This is also a good reason to go on an achievement hunt after you have finished the game. There were already speedruns in our demo. Maybe also in the finished game.

Here we have a new screenshot from the game for you. This scene will tell you a lot in the game and make you think.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40440391/b2480e1d4ffcc6e4af3fcddb6fd22def62efa01c.png[/img]

Now we have been sent another picture, however we have no idea what this is about. We are forced to post it:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40440391/c151c3b276db871fabb668f27cbf13b3a07bc0e6.png[/img]

The next days there will be more new screenshots on the store page and also again more information. Until then we wish you a nice day, have a nice christmas time and we will see you again next time!

- Troxy Studios Team

notes.title: Performance & Light adjustments
notes.notes:
[u][h2]Performance[/h2][/u]
We're getting right back to you shortly after our [b]demo for Lying Souls[/b] became available to everyone. We got a lot of good feedback from you guys. However, we did notice a few things. The majority of players don't get the performance they should. That's why we decided to look into it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40440391/f81118637f7599c7653350cc834718587d940db6.png[/img]

In this small update [b](version 1.0.3a)[/b] we have done something to the performance of the whole game. Lying Souls now offers on [b]average about 22%[/b] better frames on every graphics setting & system. We are aware that Lying Souls is a hardware hungry game. This will not change in the full version. But with this we wanted to get one step closer to good performance.

[u][h2]Light adjustments[/h2][/u]
Additionally, we noticed that some players were not able to see all of the demo content due to their screen or other settings. Some places in the playable area were displayed too dark as a result. We have fundamentally made the light a bit more realistic. You can now see more and the shadows are [b]not as dark[/b] as before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40440391/179ade3295194d9ba863e37ccc5ea0683d6b275a.png[/img]

[u][h2]Other Changes[/h2][/u] [list]
[*] You can now skip the credits at the end of the demo by pressing any key
[*] A few more small bug fixes [/list]
- Troxy Studios Team
